#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Point {
    int v, w, x, y, z;
    Point(int a, int b, int c, int d, int e) : v(a), w(b), x(c), y(d), z(e) {}
    double mag() const {
        return sqrt(v*v + w*w + x*x + y*y + z*z);
    }
};

bool angle(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    double amag = a.mag();
    double bmag = b.mag();
    double abmag = a.v * b.v + a.w * b.w + a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z;
    double angle_deg = acos(abmag / (amag * bmag)) * 180.0 / M_PI;
    return angle_deg < 90.0;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
    } else {
        vector<Point> arr;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int a, b, c, d, e;
            cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
            arr.emplace_back(a, b, c, d, e);
        }
        set<int> good;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            bool ok = true;
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (i != j && i != k && j != k) {
                        const Point& one = arr[j];
                        const Point& two = arr[k];
                        const Point& three = arr[i];
                        Point lol2(one.v - three.v, one.w - three.w, one.x - three.x, one.y - three.y, one.z - three.z);
                        Point lol1(two.v - three.v, two.w - three.w, two.x - three.x, two.y - three.y, two.z - three.z);
                        if (angle(lol1, lol2)) {
                            ok = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (ok) {
                good.insert(i + 1);
            }
        }
        cout << good.size() << "\n";
        for (int idx : good) {
            cout << idx << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
